name: plan_chute_route
summary: Find a chute route from a source to a sink and dry-run it with place_chutes and every flow guard. Answers place_arguments to build it. Read only.

help.text: plan_cable_route for chutes: from is the source and to the sink. The search never passes through a cell holding a chute, cable, pipe, device or other small-grid thing; a reroute keeps the old run's direction where the flow fixes it.
help.keys: tool, found, route {waypoints, length, bends, cost, expanded, ...}, failure, place_arguments, dry_run {tool, status, job_id, grade, ready, ...}, notes, resolved_networks.

ends.summary: Which ends can be a from or a to.
ends.text: An Output port or a chute bin is a from, an Input port a to; the other way round is invalid_argument. A rocket chute umbilical's port may be either. A chute as to: joining through an open end is free, another direction makes a junction (only where the route merges into a line). A chute as from: the route leaves only through an open end items can leave by, never an Input end, an end the flow already sends items in by, or a junction.

from.description: The source: {at}, {reference_id} of a chute, {reference_id, port}; or several starts (see routing/starts).

to.description: The sink: {at}, {reference_id} of a chute, {reference_id, port}, or {network_id} (see routing/ends).

allow_door_keepout.description: true: the search may enter a door keep-out (a warning). Default false (see doors).

assume_removed.description: Things to plan as if already gone; the kind's pieces among them are removed in the same job (place_arguments.remove_ids).

items.description: A network id, {reference_id, port}, or a device id.

allow_bridge.description: Passed on: networks and devices whose joining is meant (see networks/bridging).

root.description: Passed on: the device would_split measures against.

join_trunk.description: Add a missing tap to join_to (tap_added). Default false.

allow_split.description: Passed on: let removals split networks. Default false.

allow_split_long.description: Default true: long straights met are split in the same job.

from_id.description: Passed on: the thing whose slots pay (see materials).

limit.description: Cells the embedded dry run lists; default 5, 0 for none.
